2608.04904.title: Strengthening Target-Language Features: SAE-Based Steering for Multilingual Inference
2608.04904.paper_summary: Multilingual large language models exhibit substantial performance differences across languages, while existing adaptation methods often require parameter updates and considerable multilingual training data. We propose an inference-time multilingual steering method that uses pretrained sparse autoencoders to identify and strengthen target-language-related features. Using multilingual parallel sentences, we compare SAE activations across languages and select a small number of layer-specific features associated with each target language. These features are decoded into steering signals and injected into the model's hidden states without additional training. Experiments with Gemma-3-12B-it show average accuracy improvements of 10.9 percentage points on XCOPA, 5.3 points on XNLI, and 1.9 points on MGSM.
2608.04904.paper_summary_zh: 多語言大型語言模型在不同語言之間表現出顯著的性能差異，而現有的適應方法通常需要參數更新和大量的多語言訓練數據。我們提出了一種推理時的多語言引導方法，利用預訓練的稀疏自編碼器來識別和加強目標語言相關的特徵。使用多語言平行句子，我們比較了不同語言的 SAE 激活，並選擇與每個目標語言相關的一小部分層特定特徵。這些特徵被解碼為引導信號，並在不進行額外訓練的情況下注入到模型的隱藏狀態中。對 Gemma-3-12B-it 的實驗顯示，在 XCOPA 上平均準確率提高了 10.9 個百分點，在 XNLI 上提高了 5.3 個百分點，在 MGSM 上提高了 1.9 個百分點。
2608.04904.author: Hongsheng Wang et.al.
